name: press-sound
title: Press Sound
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Hook and wrapper that play a short synthesized click on press, with a shared mute.

meta.descriptionEs: Hook y envoltura que reproducen un clic corto sintetizado al presionar, con un silencio compartido.

examples.title: Sonido al presionar
examples.description: Hook y envoltura que reproducen un clic corto sintetizado al presionar, con un silencio compartido.

api.name: usePressSound
api.description: Returns play, muted, setMuted, and toggle.

api.name: PressSoundToggle
api.description: Button for the shared mute. Labels default to English.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Wrapper still renders the child, without a sound.

docs: Audio is generated with the Web Audio API on the press gesture. There is no audio file. Mute is shared in the tab and stored locally. No theme is shipped.
